jobs.title: Head of GTM Operations
jobs.description:
Job Description

We’re looking for a hands-on, strategic, and data-driven Head of RevOps/GTM Operations to drive the effectiveness of our Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy across Sales, Marketing, and Account Management.


As a key partner to senior leadership, you will build a high-performing Revenue Operations function, ensuring our teams have the tools, insights, and processes they need to maximise productivity and revenue performance.


Operating within a predominantly outbound sales environment, you will support a large sales organisation and help our new business teams efficiently identify and engage the right Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) at scale.


This is a new role at AppCheck, giving you the opportunity to shape and build the Revenue Operations function from the ground up. You’ll play a key role in supporting the company’s continued 30% year-on-year growth, helping scale a high-performing GTM engine around an innovative cyber security SaaS product at the forefront of vulnerability scanning and security research.


Core Responsibilities :


Revenue Operations & Strategy:


  • Develop and implement a scalable Revenue Operations framework.
  • Own and optimise the end-to-end revenue funnel.
  • Provide data-driven insights to inform strategic decisions, including sales performance, pipeline velocity, and renewal trends.
  • Support a high-volume outbound sales organisation (50+ team), ensuring GTM teams maximise time spent on revenue-generating activity.
  • Define and optimise ICP targeting, ensuring sales teams are working the highest value accounts and opportunities.


Process & System Optimisation:


  • Streamline and enhance sales, marketing, and account management processes.
  • Drive data accuracy and quality, implementing training, reporting, and governance to maintain clean and reliable data.
  • Audit and optimise the existing CRM environment, improving the structure, usability, and integrity of large volumes of sales and account data.
  • Implement and enforce clear data governance rules and standards to ensure CRM data remains structured, reliable, and actionable.
  • Work with sales leadership to ensure SDR/AE alignment with data, accounts, and opportunities.


GTM Technology & Data Enablement:


  • Maximise the value of the current Go-To-Market technology stack, ensuring tools such as Cognism, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn, G2, Leadoo and Salesforce are effectively utilised.
  • Identify opportunities to improve GTM efficiency through better utilisation or investment in additional technologies.
  • Lead initiatives to embed AI-driven capabilities into the GTM function, improving prospecting efficiency and productivity.
  • Enhance the use of Salesforce to capture richer data on companies and opportunities to support multi-threaded selling.


Performance Measurement & Enablement:


  • Develop and manage reporting dashboards, providing real-time insights on sales effectiveness, marketing performance, and customer retention.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Account Management to drive enablement, coaching, training, and process adoption.


Skills & Experience:


  • 3+ years of experience in Revenue Operations or Sales Operations within a high-growth SaaS or cyber security industry; 5+ years of experience in marketing/sales/go to market overall.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience leveraging data-driven insights to optimise performance – experience with SQL/data visualisation software such as Tableau would be advantageous.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce, and other GTM tools, with a strong understanding of CRM, automation, and reporting best practices.
  • Experience working with large outbound sales teams and managing operational processes that support high-volume prospecting environments.
  • Proven ability to lead and manage cross-functional teams, driving alignment across Sales, Marketing, and Account Management.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing senior leadership.
  • Experience working with modern prospecting tools and data providers (e.g., Cognism, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, G2, Salesforce).
  • Interest or experience in applying AI tools within GTM or revenue operations functions.
  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset, with the ability to identify inefficiencies and implement scalable solutions.


Location:


We’re based in Birstall, just outside of Leeds, but we’re flexible on days in the office. We operate a hybrid model overall and we’re happy for this role to come in 2-4 days per month depending on your location and preferences.


Additional Info:


As part of our commitment to information security and our ISO 27001 accreditation, please note that upon acceptance of an employment offer with AppCheck, you will undergo pre-employment checks including criminal record (DBS), employment & references as well as verification of Right to Work in the UK.


Please apply ASAP as interviews may commence before the closing date, and the vacancy may close early without prior warning.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity.

Job Description

Highly Specialist Cardiac Physiologist

Nuffield Health Leeds Hospital | Cardiology

Permanent | Full-Time (37.5 Hours)

Up to £50,000 (DOE) | Includes £2,000 "Welcome Bonus"

Part-Time hours will also be considered for this role (3 days)


At Nuffield Health, we’re looking for an excellent communicator to join our Cardiac Unit. As part of the team, you’ll enjoy the chance to help shape an outstanding patient experience. Bring your commitment to building the highest standards of care and we’ll offer the ideal home for your career.


As a Highly Specialist Cardiac Physiologist at our Leeds Hospital, you’ll hold a BSc in Clinical Physiology (or equivalent), hold a registration to RCCP/AHCS; demonstrate BHRS/IBHRE Devices Accreditation, and have at least two years’ experience at highly specialist level post completion of devices accreditation.


The post holder will perform a comprehensive range of cardiac diagnostic tests and procedures. They will be responsible for interpreting results, delivering precise, clinically relevant reports to support medical decision-making whilst supporting other healthcare professionals whilst fostering clinical excellence across the team.


Main duties of the job

  • Perform a broad range of procedures in the cardiac cath lab as part of the multidisciplinary team (MDT) including: diagnostic coronary angiography, percutaneous coronary intervention, right heart catheterisation, and PFO/ASD closures. Monitoring ECG and pressure tracings throughout, promptly reporting any abnormalities/significant changes to the wider team.
  • Support cardiac device implants monitoring ECG and intra-cardiac signals to ensure accurate lead placement, promptly reporting any abnormalities/significant changes.
  • Lead cardiac device follow-up clinics in line with BHRS guidelines, clinical governance standards, and local standard operating procedure. Assess device function, battery status, make clinically appropriate programming changes optimising device performance and battery longevity and maintain accurate records to support audit, service improvement, and governance.
  • Ensure that appropriate Cardiac Device stock is available for implantation procedures.
  • Deliver high-quality testing, interpreting, analysis and reporting where appropriate of all non-invasive cardiology tests including: ECG’s, Ambulatory ECG’s, Ambulatory BP’s, Exercise Tolerance Tests with all non-invasive testing being performed and reported in accordance to national guidelines and local standard operating procedures.
  • Timely and accurate Ambulatory ECG analysis and reporting accounts for a significant proportion of daily workload.
  • Provide expert clinical leadership and specialist technical guidance in the implantation and follow-up of cardiac devices, serving the department and wider hospital.
  • Act as a clinical role model, promoting evidence-based best practice to enhance care quality for outpatients, inpatients, and surgical patients.
